Sers les commandes des supporters avant: Serve the fans' orders before they lose patience.
Cours le long de la touche, attrape les: Run along the touchline, catch the balls that go out and throw them back fast.
Annonce les buteurs au micro, dans le te: Announce the scorers on the mic, on the beat, and get the whole stand to answer.
Peins les grandes bâches du capo d'après: Paint the capo's big canvases from the model, before the players come out.
Tends à chaque supporter l'écharpe aux c: Hand each fan the scarf in their club's colours.
